title: What's New: Capturing SQL Calls in Performance Profiles (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Profiling recap and in-client profiler history
Schedule profiles and SQL details feature

features.name: SQL call tracking in performance profiles
features.description: Added ability to track SQL course calls when using the in-client profiler in the web client as well as when capturing snapshots from Visual Studio Code. Shows total duration of SQL calls, number of calls, and allows drilling into the actual SQL queries made.
caveats: SQL information only shown for AL calls in the call stack as part of sampling

features.name: Performance profiler in-client tool
features.description: Allows users to start and stop recording of a flow of user actions in the web client to investigate performance issues. Shows extensions involved, total execution time, and detailed breakdown by application objects and call tree.

features.name: Schedule profiles
features.description: Allows capture of performance profiles automatically and non-interactively in the background based on well-defined rules. Partner can set up rules and users perform daily tasks while profiles are captured automatically.

features.name: SQL call visualization in Visual Studio Code
features.description: SQL call information is available inside Visual Studio Code when viewing snapshots or importing profiles. Users can hover over calls to see full SQL query and copy it.

features.name: HTTP call tracking in performance profiles
features.description: Performance profiling also tracks outbound HTTP calls, showing the number of outbound calls and their duration alongside SQL call metrics.
